title: Now that Character.AI is going bankrupt, what happens to all of its users’ data?
hook_text: Character.AI faces a multi-state AG probe.
script:
Character.AI is facing bankruptcy and a multi-state investigation.
New York Attorney General Letitia James revealed the years-long probe as bankruptcy proceedings begin.
Forty bipartisan attorneys general filed a notice of interest in the bankruptcy case.
The coalition is moving to require strict protections on consumer data sold through the proceeding.
The legal action aims to address regulatory issues regarding user information before assets change hands.
Would you trust a bankruptcy court with your chat history?
